findings.F1: The book's gain is almost all timing, not the market's rise: of the summed position gain of 4.02 over 729 held coin-days (100 % long, all in the falling agitated regime), the market's own rise accounts for 0.38 and timing for 3.64, about 91 %.
findings.F2: In the falling agitated profile the next day reverses the day's move on both sides: after down days the next-day excess return is +1.25 % (t 5.31, 658 non-overlapping cases); after up days it is −0.85 % (t −3.62, 639 cases); the slope over all profile days is t 2.64. This is the effect of 058-02.b1.g1.b1.b1, "falling agitated next day reversal", which the map already holds.
findings.F3: Outside the profile the down-day rebound is absent. The slope of next-day excess return on the scaled fall has t 0.12 in falling markets (734 days), 0.93 in rising markets (885) and 1.24 in choppy markets (369), so the gain lives in falling agitated markets only.
findings.F4: The plan's 20-day scaling grades the rebound weakly, and its grading rests on 16 extreme days. Over positive-forecast days the slope on the 20-day-scaled fall has a clustered t of 1.74 (658 days). Without the 16 days below −3 swings, which rebound +8.6 % the next day, it falls to t 1.31, and the forecast's slope falls from t 2.08 to 1.13.
findings.F5: Measured differently, the same rebound is graded clearly. The slope on the raw one-day fall has t 3.90 (782 days), and on the fall scaled by the 60-day swing it has t 3.55 (428 days). The test measured the grading with the comparison where it is weakest.
findings.F6: The rebound is concentrated on falls that end a multi-day drop. Among big down days (below −1 swing), those in the deepest third of 5-day returns rebound +3.66 % the next day (102 cases), against +0.07 % (34) and +0.74 % (26) in the other thirds. Small down days after a deep 5-day fall still rebound +2.01 % (43), against −0.11 % (114) for the middle third.
findings.F7: The book's profit is concentrated in a few periods and trades. Windows w16 and w14 give 0.196 and 0.131 of the 0.52 summed daily book return (63 %), with down-day rebounds of +3.39 % and +0.93 %. The top 20 of 693 trades give 439 of the 803 summed net percent (55 %). By year, 2020 alone shows +6.6 % per big fall (29 cases).

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's fall over the last 5 days, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In an agitated downtrend, a trader has a reason to buy after a multi-day slide for one day, sized by how deep the 5-day fall is, rather than by a single day's move.
ideas.name: agitated downtrend five-day slide rebound

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against its usual daily swing over the last 60 days, the larger its rise over the next day.
ideas.consequence: In an agitated downtrend, a trader has a reason to buy a sharp down day for one day, measuring the fall against the coin's swing over two months rather than the last few weeks.
ideas.name: downtrend fall versus 60-day swing
